description: In check_revocation_against_anchor, the delta CRL path calls verify_delta_crl_and_collect without the three-way issuer cross-check that check_revocation performs (delta issuer == base CRL issuer AND delta issuer == cert's issuer). The anchor path offers one fewer guard than the cert-issuer path. Fix: parse the delta DER before calling verify_delta_crl_and_collect and verify its issuer matches both the base CRL issuer and cert.tbs_certificate.issuer. File: pkix-revocation/src/crl.rs lines 400-410.
title: crl: delta CRL anchor path missing issuer cross-check
